description: Set where a surgeon stands in a product segment: target, contacted, trialing, using_us, competitor (with which competitor, if known), lost, passed or unknown. A surgeon can be a customer in one segment and a target in another (using us for sports medicine, not yet for shoulder), so name the segment when the rep does; omit it for the surgeon in general. With using_us, share says how much of their cases in the segment the rep has (some, half, most, all): a customer at some or half is room to grow. using_us also marks them a customer (warm paths start from them); lost from using_us unmarks them unless another segment is still using us. Every change is kept in the history. Shared with the rep's team.

competitor.description: With competitor or lost: the company they use as the company reports it, e.g. Stryker.

npi.description: 10-digit NPI; use search to find it.

segment.description: The product segment: ortho, spine-pain, biologics, cardio, neuro, gensurg, uro-gyn, ent, eye, onc-ir or dme (a procedure key such as knee-arthroplasty reads as its segment). Omit for the surgeon in general.

share.description: With using_us: how much of their cases in the segment the rep has.
